answer: Farming becomes a hollow bet on surviving 62 epochs of grading, and every crystal settlement recomputes the raven schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 62 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
